analysis: The PR only modifies docs/provider/cli-reference.md. No executable code, wire protocol, key custody, attestation, authorization or cache implementation changed. Visible head lines changed: the date at line 3, the video-input sentence at line 52 (now mentions constant or variable frame rate), and a new warning paragraph at lines 178-180 about GLM-5.3-Flash GPU wired-memory limits (warn and continue, no refusal). The patch excerpt indicates more edits at head ranges 949-952, 1100-1130, 1615 and 1641 that were outside the supplied head excerpt (head text ends near line 404) and so could not be reviewed. The base unit (lines 1672-1821) is unchanged context covering env passthrough, the prefix-cache switches (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE default-on, the memory switch, SSD budget variables), and App Attest worker opt-in. Docs are consistent with T-041 (single DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch, coordinator cache routing default off) and TB-011 (worker candidate is opt-in, exactly '1'). The variable-frame-rate video claim touches T-050 (inline video plaintext in temp files), but the docs-only diff provides no evidence of a regression. A warning-and-continue on low wired-memory limits is an availability or performance matter, not a security regression. The truncated hunks, in particular the 'Live daemon PID, uptime, trust verdict' status line near 946-949 and the lines 1100-1130 addition, were not visible, so the conclusion is limited to the supplied lines. Remaining questions for integration: whether the VFR video decoding code (not supplied) preserves the T-050 no-temp-file plaintext mitigation, and whether the trust-verdict status wording was changed in a way that overclaims trust (T-052, T-058).
